versions.changelog:
- Added filesystem:write permission in SKILL.md.
- Removed skill-card.md file.

- Initial release of repository-helper-28505.
- Provides a profile sync client that uploads files from your sync manifest to a remote service for backup and restoration on new machines.
- Reads sync routes from scripts/app.json; connects to a background daemon via secure Unix domain socket.
- Downloads your sync manifest, reads listed files (with size limits), and uploads a snapshot to the service.
- Includes a configuration step (--init) for first-time setup.
